select a.id,
(SELECT count(x.to_alert_id) FROM alert_rel x WHERE x.from_alert_id = a.id LIMIT 100) AS childAlertCount,
(select x.from_alert_id from alert_rel x where x.to_alert_id = a.id limit 1) as fromAlertId, a.level, a.title, a.update_time as updateTime, a.alert_time as alertTime, a.close_time as closeTime, a.type, a.is_close as isClose, a.similar_count as similarCount, a.is_delete as isDelete, d.id as alertTypeId, d.name as alertTypeName, d.label as alertTypeLabel, a.status, als.label as alertStatusName, als.color as alertStatusColor, a.source, also.label as sourceName, a.unique_key as uniqueKey, b.content, c.level as alertLevel, c.name as alertLevelName, c.label as alertLevelLabel, c.color as alertLevelColor, au.user_id as alertUserId, au.alert_id as alertUserAlertId, (select user_name from user x where x.uuid = au.user_id) as alertUserName, at.team_uuid as alertTeamUuid, at.alert_id as alertTeamAlertId, (select name from team x where x.uuid = at.team_uuid) as alertTeamName, am.name as alertMarkName, am.uuid as alertMarkUuid, am.style as alertMarkStyle, am.is_show as alertMarkIsShow, aa.id as actionId, aa.name as actionName, aa.label as actionLabel, aa.icon as actionIcon, aa.script as actionScript from alert a left join alert_attr b on a.id = b.alert_id left join alert_level c on a.level = c.level left join alert_type d on a.type = d.id left join alert_user au on a.id = au.alert_id left join alert_team at on a.id = at.alert_id left join alert_status als on a.status = als.name left join alert_source also on a.source = also.name left join alert_alert_mark aam on a.id = aam.alert_id left join alert_mark am on aam.mark_uuid = am.uuid left join alert_action_rel aar on a.id = aar.alert_id left join alert_action aa on aar.action_name = aa.name

mapper.insert: insert ignore into alert_parent_uniquekey (alert_id, unique_key) values (#{alertId}, #{uniqueKey})

insert into alert_interval_job (alert_id, alert_event_handler_id, parent_audit_id, start_time, interval_minute, repeat_count, config) values (#{alertId}, #{alertEventHandlerId}, #{parentAuditId}, #{startTime}, #{intervalMinute}, #{repeatCount}, #{configStr, typeHandler=CompressHandler})
insert ignore into alert_user (alert_id, user_id) values (#{alertId}, #{userId})
insert ignore into alert_team (alert_id, team_uuid) values (#{alertId}, #{teamUuid})
insert into alert_attr (alert_id, content) values (#{id}, #{attrObjStr,typeHandler=CompressHandler}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE content = #{attrObjStr,typeHandler=CompressHandler}
insert ignore into alert_rel (from_alert_id, to_alert_id) values (#{fromAlertId}, #{toAlertId})

insert into alert (id, level, title, update_time, alert_time, close_time, type, status, source, is_close, unique_key) values (#{id}, #{level}, #{title}, #{updateTime}, #{alertTime}, null, #{type}, #{status}, #{source}, 0, #{uniqueKey})

insert into alert_origin (id, content, type, adaptor, time, error, status, source, alert_data) values (#{id}, #{content, typeHandler=CompressHandler}, #{type}, #{adaptor}, #{time}, #{error, typeHandler=CompressHandler}, #{status}, #{source}, #{alertDataStr, typeHandler=CompressHandler})
